about: Every number mmt shows: on the roadmap page, in ROADMAP.md, in a PR or a report. One entry per thing measured, with every point it ever had and the target it is heading for. Record a point with python bench/measures.py add; print a table for a PR with python bench/measures.py table. A point carries its date, value, how many runs (n), what it was measured on, and where the receipt is. Cold and warm are separate measures, and so is the same check on another loader: a measure only ever compares the same work. A measure with 'computed' gets its points from the ledger or the roadmap at render time instead of from 'points'. A target with value null is set once its step measures a baseline. 'context' measures are other people's numbers we compare against, and 'info' measures are facts worth showing; neither has a target. Every other measure has one. The measures that say most about each goal are named in that goal's 'headline' in coverage/roadmap.json.
